description.value: Centre 64 is Kimberley's community arts hub, operated by the Kimberley Arts Council in partnership with the City of Kimberley. It hosts a 126-seat theatre, a 1,050 sq ft gallery with two-storey ceilings, a pottery studio, and regular programming spanning film screenings, live theatre, live music, and art workshops. A touring cyclist looking to engage with local culture would find a lively, year-round venue at the heart of this Bavarian-themed mountain town.
